_comment: 音声マニフェスト。file のパスに mp3 を置けば自動で使われます(無いときはコード内の簡易シンセ音)。prompt は tools/elevenlabs/generate_audio.py が ElevenLabs へ送る英語プロンプトです。

title.prompt: Cheerful, dreamy children's game title theme. Bright glockenspiel and marimba melody over soft synth pads, light pizzicato strings, gentle bouncy rhythm, sense of floating in a pastel sky full of cubes. 100 BPM, major key, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

story.prompt: Gentle storybook cinematic underscore for a kids' game cutscene. Celesta, harp arpeggios, warm strings, soft music box, wonder and a hint of mystery, slow 72 BPM, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

stage1.prompt: Playful upbeat puzzle-platformer stage music for children. Bouncy synth bass, plucky marimba lead, claps and light drums, curious and happy mood, 112 BPM, major key, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

stage2.prompt: Energetic yet cute climbing-tower level music. Funky clavinet and chiptune-style square lead, driving drums, slightly mysterious minor-to-major chord changes, sense of going upward, 120 BPM, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

stage3.prompt: Exciting final-stage music in a starry night sky. Sparkling synth arpeggios, soaring strings, bright bells, uplifting adventurous drums, magical and heroic but kid friendly, 128 BPM, major key, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

result.prompt: Happy celebration jingle and loop for a results screen in a kids' game. Brass stabs, glockenspiel, claps, joyful and proud, 104 BPM, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

ending.prompt: Warm, emotional ending theme for a cute adventure game. Piano and strings with music box, gentle choir pad (no lyrics), feeling of the night sky lighting up again, 80 BPM, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

credits.prompt: Relaxed, sparkling staff-roll music for a children's game. Soft electric piano, celesta, light shuffle drums, dreamy pads, flying through a starry sky, 88 BPM, seamless loop, instrumental, no vocals.

ui_select.prompt: Cute bright UI confirm blip, soft bubbly pop with a tiny sparkle, game menu button

ui_back.prompt: Soft cute UI cancel sound, gentle descending two-note blip, game menu

ui_hover.prompt: Very short soft tick for UI hover, tiny wooden click, quiet

ui_toggle.prompt: Short cute toggle switch sound, two quick plucky notes, game settings menu

jump.prompt: Cartoon jump sound, springy rising boing, cute and light, short

land.prompt: Soft squishy landing thump of a small round mochi-like character on a plastic block, short

land_big.prompt: Heavy but cute landing impact, deep soft thud with a bouncy squish and small whoosh tail

gravity.prompt: Magical gravity shift whoosh, rising swirling air sweep with sparkly chime, the world rotates, cartoon game

gravity_fail.prompt: Short soft dull buzz meaning not possible, gentle low blip, cute game UI

star.prompt: Collecting a star piece, bright ascending glockenspiel arpeggio with sparkle shimmer, cheerful game pickup

goal_open.prompt: Magical gate opening chime, shimmering harp glissando and bells, rewarding

goal.prompt: Reaching the goal star, triumphant short fanfare with bells, sparkles and a soft magical whoosh, kids game

hazard.prompt: Cartoon electric zap, short buzzy crackle, playful not scary

respawn.prompt: Character respawn sound, soft magical rising shimmer with a gentle pop

fall_out.prompt: Cartoon falling away into the sky, descending slide whistle, funny and light

crumble.prompt: Cute stone block crumbling apart, light rubble and soft crunch, cartoon

crack.prompt: Small crack sound of a block starting to break, short crisp tick

go.prompt: Start signal, bright short whistle-like synth chord, game start GO

whoosh.prompt: Soft cinematic air whoosh, camera swooping through the sky

shatter.prompt: Giant magical star shattering into glittering pieces, crystal glass break with sparkling chimes, fantasy, not violent

sparkle.prompt: Twinkling sparkle sound, magic fairy dust chimes, short

rank.prompt: Stamp landing with a thump followed by a bright celebration chime, results screen

pop.prompt: Small soft firework pop with tiny crackle, distant and cute
